title: Replace base R messaging/error calls with cli equivalents across R/ sources
body:
- [x] R/MethodsHotgenes.R — replaced `stop()` (20 calls), `warning()` (1), `message()` (3) with cli equivalents
- [x] R/GSEA.R — replaced `stop()` (12 calls) and `print(y)` debug call
- [x] R/GSVA.R — replaced `stop()` (1) and `warning()` (1)
- [x] R/Hotgenes.R — replaced `stop()` (6 calls)
- [x] R/Heatmap.R, R/VennDiagram.R — replaced `stop()` (1 each)
- [x] R/Shiny_support_utilities.R — replaced `print()` and `stop()`
- [x] R/Shiny_Hotgenes_UI_Module.R — replaced `print()` (3 debug calls)
- [x] R/Shiny_Tabs.R — replaced debug `print()`, `renderPlot(print(plot))`, piped `paste0(...) %>% print()`
- [x] Remove `glue::glue_collapse()` wrappers from `cli::cli_inform()` calls — use bare `{vector}` interpolation
- [x] Remove `paste(..., collapse)` wrappers from `cli::cli_abort()` calls — use bare `{vector}` interpolation
